notes.title: New version of Elven Love is available!
notes.notes:
Hello!
Elven Love has been updated. We've got a new intro with proper introduction to the game and more. Hope you'll like the stuff!

[h1]Changes:[/h1][list]
[*] Intro with proper introduction to the story added
[*] Main tutorial updated - it now explains controls, wands and quests
[*] Ending scene updated to suit the overall story
[*] Fixed fingers stretching bug with some poses and animations
[*] Fixed the bug with enabling/disabling clothes option after undressing both the Elves [/list]
 
Thank you for all the support! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New version is up!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
We've got a new update for you. Here's the list of changes that has been made: [list]
[*] Progress reset button added to the menu
[*] Clothes enable/disable option is now available in the menu after undressing both of the elves
[*] Option for directional teleport added to the menu - changes player rotation while teleporting by using touchpad / thumbstick location
[*] Few other minor tweaks [/list]
Thanks for all your support. More changes incoming!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, we're back with another update to Elven Love.
Here's the list of changes:
[List]
[*] Player rotation option added to the menu - Thumbstick for Oculus and Touchpad for Vive
[*] Fixed collisions for some of the objects
[*] Interactions and picking up items improved, objects handling unified
[*] Lost objects now move back to initial location.
[*] Options panel tweaked
[/list]
More coming soon!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello!
We are really sorry for the release date postponement. We've encountered some Steam related problems. The delay gives us more time for improvements and will positively affect the game.

[h1]The final release date for Elven Love is 16.03.2018![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31959183/def2fcad23cf1187adba5edd0b4d46314d2cc944.png[/img]

We are working hard to deliver the best quality. 
Thank you for your patience.
